cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Handle the Evidence
cards.instruction: Make someone else take responsibility for the evidence, loose end, or difficult follow-up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll close the raffle accounts today. Explain my missing magician's receipt to the treasurer; you booked him.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You paid him. I only found his number.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you've got the number. I'll send the payment date; get us a replacement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already rang. He needs the treasurer to email him directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Draft her email. I'll get her to send it; copy yourself in so you can chase the reply.

reason: Give B an explicit completed call and A supporting payment/treasurer coordination; A still makes B own drafting and chasing the missing evidence as each new fact arrives.
